<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="stuns-mechanics-overview" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Stuns &amp; Mechanics Overview</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/fb0VtpIAFc.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Kalphite_King <nowiki>Kalphite King</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513212971409866765.png?v=1" alt="kalphiteking" title="kalphiteking" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is a powerful kalphite found within the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Exiled_Kalphite_Hive <nowiki>Exiled Kalphite Hive</nowiki>]<nowiki> just north of Menaphos. KK can use three combat styles, but he will only use one style at a time with a set attack rotation for each style. At any time throughout the fight, KK can randomly change attack style, starting a new attack rotation.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>KK is a significant step up in difficulty in comparison to other mid-tier bosses, requiring close tracking of auto attacks and specs, and the use of specific abilites at certain times to dodge one-hit mechanics.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Being on a Kalphite slayer task </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is recommended as you gain the benefits of the Slayer Helm </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1" alt="slayerhelm" title="slayerhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Genocidal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1" alt="genocidal" title="genocidal" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Attack Rotation</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Ranged Phase: 2 Autos → Stun → 2 Autos → Green → 2 Autos → Dig → Repeat
⬥ Melee Phase: 2 Autos → Push → 2 Autos → Charge → 2 Autos → Green → Repeat
⬥ Mage Phase: 4 Autos → Dig → 2 Autos → Charge → Repeat
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Greens (Beetlejuice)</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Kalphite King stuns and binds the tank for 8 seconds, leaving them unable to do anything. He then deals a melee attack that can hit up to 32k damage. Greens only happen during ranged and melee phase. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/XX7mCy9.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Ranged phase: the Green can be skipped via stunning KK at the right time.
    • Melee phase: you cannot skip the Green, instead you must utilise the Bladed Dive technique discussed later.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Green Shield (random)</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Kalphite King heals 75% of all damage dealt by players. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/HzN16w4.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Red Shield (random)</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Kalphite King heals 100% of all damage dealt to players. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/9dSKMqO.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Digs</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Kalphite King becomes unattackable and digs under the ground for 10 seconds, it then appears under the player it last targeted, dealing up to 5k damage if not avoided. Digs only happen on ranged and magic phase. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/pvgMnLU.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Charges</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Kalphite King becomes unattackable and charges towards a wall, players who fail to avoid the space between the charging boss and wall will be hit up to 4k damage. Charges only happen on melee and magic phase. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/VXwsTOU.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Minions</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Kalphite King spawns minions when it reaches 195k (1 wave) and 65k HP (2 waves). All players within a 3 tile radius of KK will be stunned for one second before the minions appear. Minions spawning will also cause KK to skip whatever attack he would have done next, including special attacks. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/MU1A7WL.mp4 <nowiki>Example</nowiki>]<nowiki>
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="kalphite-king-attack-pattern"><ins><nowiki>Kalphite King Attack Pattern</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/oXYt0ZL.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="player-stun-timings"><ins><nowiki>Player Stun Timings</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Stunning KK at the right time is essential, allowing you skip certain mechanics that either waste time (charge &amp; dig) or result in a death/failed kill (Green).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="ranged-phase-skips-green"><nowiki>Ranged Phase: Skips Green</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>2 Autos → Stun → 2 Autos → </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Your Stun</nowiki></strong><nowiki> → 2 Autos → Dig → Repeat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="melee-phase-skips-charge"><nowiki>Melee Phase: Skips Charge</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>2 Autos → Push → 2 Autos → </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Your Stun</nowiki></strong><nowiki> → 2 Autos → Green → Repeat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="mage-phase-skips-dig"><nowiki>Mage Phase: Skips Dig</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>4 Autos → </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Your Stun</nowiki></strong><nowiki> → 2 Autos → Charge → Repeat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="step-by-step-bladed-dive-guide"><ins><nowiki>Step-by-step Bladed Dive Guide</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Don’t </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> during ranged phase. Always skip green with a stun. If you use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879330148352.png?v=1" alt="destroy" title="destroy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> remember to cancel after 1 GCD.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Melee charge happens or is skipped.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If learning, </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not</nowiki></strong><nowiki> skipping charge is recommended so you can learn how to get an accurate count on attacks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Count 2 KK autos.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Equip shield or defender if you are learning. Can be done after </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> when more experienced.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Freedom </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Let the boss green you</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Queue </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and aim away from walls and minions</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Never </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> through KK</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Look at the stun timer</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ As the timer drops from 4 to 3 seconds, click the Bladed Dive spot</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Quickly equip shield or defender if not already equipped</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (Only </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if there are no minions)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/61XGHbW.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: If you get greened solo, you can spam Freedom </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and a teleport to avoid death.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="strategies-and-tips"><ins><nowiki>Strategies and Tips</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="general"><nowiki>General</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Anticipate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1" alt="anti" title="anti" kind="icon" /><nowiki> before and Berserk </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at the start of every kill.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Never stun outside of proper stun timings.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stay close to the tank during digs but not in the surface radius.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Run with the boss during charges.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Anticipate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1" alt="anti" title="anti" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Freedom </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at the start of Ranged </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> phases, use the other defensive when your first runs out.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Don’t stand directly between KK and a wall during melee or mage phase or you will be hit up to 5k.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="melee-form"><nowiki>Melee Form </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="Attack" title="Attack" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use Freedom </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on melee phase only after you receive both bleeds. If you </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki> a Dismember </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1" alt="dismember" title="dismember" kind="icon" /><nowiki> before you get Slaughtered </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879237873666.png?v=1" alt="slaughter" title="slaughter" kind="icon" /><nowiki> be prepared to take hefty damage, especially if you get pushed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="ranged-form"><nowiki>Ranged Form </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The amount of times you get hit by the standard attack while the Incendiary Shot icon </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258429661215.png?v=1" alt="incend" title="incend" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is on your buff bar is the amount of times you will be hit by the Incendiary Shot </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258429661215.png?v=1" alt="incend" title="incend" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If you get a stun with the Incendiary Shot </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258429661215.png?v=1" alt="incend" title="incend" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after green, don’t freedom. Either wait until the stun clears and GBarge </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1" alt="gbarge" title="gbarge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to KK when he surfaces or GBarge </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1" alt="gbarge" title="gbarge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to minions to clear and then Bladed Dive </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> back to KK.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="magic-form"><nowiki>Magic Form </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use Devotion </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> during the first 4 autos of this phase so you can continue to attack the boss without moving.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Anticipate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1" alt="anti" title="anti" kind="icon" /><nowiki> during charge.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Resonance </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> the blue ball.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Usually happens the attack after charge if you forget how to count.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="what-you-must-avoid"><ins><nowiki>What you must avoid</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="general_1"><nowiki>General</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Never use Smoke Tendrils </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536257336130404372.png?v=1" alt="Smoke_Tendrils" title="Smoke_Tendrils" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Unload </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258664411169.png?v=1" alt="unload" title="unload" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, or Frenzy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879279554581.png?v=1" alt="frenzy" title="frenzy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Attack minions at a time where the Kalphite King is still attackable.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Never stun outside of proper stun timings. If you do you could cause:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Early greens.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Early charges.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Early digs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Skipped attacks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A sped-up attack rotation.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Never stun during a Green. If you do you could cause:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Multiple greens.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Early digs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Multiple digs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
